# voipms_did (Data Source)

Reads a single DID (`getDIDsInfo`).


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "voipms_did" "home" {
  did = "5550001001"
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `did` (String) Phone number.

### Read-Only

- `billing_type` (String) Billing type.
- `callerid_prefix` (String) Caller ID prefix.
- `cnam` (Boolean) CNAM lookup enabled.
- `description` (String) Rate-center / city description.
- `dialmode` (String) SMS dialing mode.
- `dialtime` (Number) Ring time in seconds.
- `e911` (Boolean) E911 provisioned.
- `failover_busy` (String) Busy failover route.
- `failover_noanswer` (String) No-answer failover route.
- `failover_unreachable` (String) Unreachable failover route.
- `id` (String) Same as `did`.
- `mms_available` (Boolean) MMS capable.
- `next_billing` (String) Next billing date.
- `note` (String) DID note.
- `order_date` (String) Order date.
- `pop` (Number) Point-of-presence id.
- `record_calls` (Boolean) Inbound call recording.
- `routing` (String) Inbound route.
- `sms_available` (Boolean) SMS capable.
- `sms_email` (String) SMS email address.
- `sms_email_enabled` (Boolean) SMS email delivery enabled.
- `sms_enabled` (Boolean) SMS enabled.
- `sms_forward` (String) SMS forward destination.
- `sms_forward_enabled` (Boolean) SMS forwarding enabled.
- `sms_sipaccount` (String) SIP account used to send SMS.
- `sms_sipaccount_enabled` (Boolean) SIP-account SMS sending enabled.
- `sms_url_callback` (String) Legacy SMS URL callback.
- `sms_url_callback_enabled` (Boolean) Legacy URL callback enabled.
- `sms_url_callback_retry` (Boolean) Legacy URL callback retry.
- `voicemail` (String) Attached mailbox.
- `voicemail_threshold` (Number) Voicemail threshold.
- `webhook` (String) Modern SMS webhook URL.
- `webhook_enabled` (Boolean) Modern webhook enabled.
